Integrate AI agent identity and

management (IAM) into the organization’s existing IAM ecosystem. AI agents can act on behalf of humans and nonhuman identities. To avoid AI agents having unauthorized
access
to sensitive data: 1) human and nonhuman identities must authenticate and authorize to AI agents, and 2) AI agents must authenticate and authorize to back-end resources. Identity and
access
management for AI agents is not a standalone IAM domain.
